message.content:
The illustration, set against a solid red background, is a magazine cover with the word "TEMPO" in large black serif font at the top. Below this, smaller text reads "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU". At the very top, white text reads "ORANG ISTANA JADI PANGLIMA" and "ZUMI ZOLA OLALA".

In the foreground, a man in a black suit, white shirt, red tie, and a black peci cap is shown in profile facing right. He holds a white paper cup with "#JOKO" printed on it in his right hand. White vapor rises from the cup. Behind him are two framed pictures on the wall. The left frame shows a horizontal red and white rectangular pattern. The right frame depicts two men's faces and several hands pressed against glass, as if trapped inside.

To the right, large white text reads "BEREBUT KURSI NO. 2", followed by a paragraph in smaller white text. In the bottom-left corner, there is a barcode, several numbers, and publication details like "11-17 DESEMBER 2017", "RP 45.000", and "WWW.TEMPO.CO". All elements are crisply rendered in a clean, graphic style.
